scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.lint: biome check packages/ vitest.setup.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write --unsafe packages/ vitest.setup.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/agent-config/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/agent-config/tsconfig.type-tests.json && tsc -p packages/agent-runtime-worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/control-plane/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cockpit/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.verify:quick: npm run lint && npm run audit:tripwires && npm run audit:structure && npm run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run verify:quick && npm run test:coverage
scripts.security: npm run security:sast && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:deps
